# LexigenZ — AI & Agent Reference File
# https://lexigenz.com/llms.txt
# Generated: 2026-06-21
# Standard: llms.txt v1 (https://llmstxt.org)

> LexigenZ is a South African daily vocabulary web app designed for Gen Z and millennials. It delivers a personalised word of the day based on the user's birth archetype, offers vocabulary building through streaks, badges, a word journal, and six word games — across 19 languages. The platform also functions as a programmatic vocabulary reference with thousands of indexed word pages, category hubs, and vocabulary lists.

## Product Summary

LexigenZ (lexigenz.com) is a vocabulary improvement platform that combines:
- Daily personalised word of the day (based on 12 birth archetypes)
- Six word games: Spelling Bee, Wordle-style, Scrabble helper, Crossword solver, Word Search, Anagram solver
- Vocabulary streaks and badge system
- Word journal for saving and reviewing learned words
- Support for 19 languages
- Programmatic word reference pages (meaning, synonyms, antonyms, usage, sentences)
- Vocabulary list pages (100 advanced words, 500 business words, 1000 SAT words, etc.)
- Category pages (words by letter, theme, difficulty)

## Capabilities for AI Agents

LexigenZ exposes structured, machine-readable data at the following endpoints:

### Word Data API
- GET /api/words — paginated word index
- GET /api/words/:word — full word data (definition, synonyms, antonyms, examples, difficulty)
- GET /api/words/:word/synonyms — synonym list
- GET /api/words/:word/antonyms — antonym list
- GET /api/words/:word/sentences — example sentences

### Vocabulary Lists API
- GET /api/lists — all vocabulary list metadata
- GET /api/lists/:slug — words in a specific list (e.g. advanced-100, business-500, sat-1000)

### Category API
- GET /api/categories — all word categories
- GET /api/categories/letter/:letter — words starting with a given letter
- GET /api/categories/ending/:suffix — words ending with a given suffix
- GET /api/categories/theme/:theme — words by theme (business, academic, positive, motivational)

### Word of the Day
- GET /api/word-of-the-day — today's featured word with full data

## Site Structure

### Core Pages
- / — Home, daily word, archetype picker
- /about — About LexigenZ and its mission
- /how-it-works — Feature walkthrough
- /play — Word games hub (Spelling Bee, Wordle, Scrabble, Crossword, Word Search, Anagram)
- /app — Personalised vocabulary dashboard
- /premium — Premium plan features and pricing
- /articles — Vocabulary articles and guides

### Programmatic Word Pages (300,000+ pages)
- /word/:word — Full word reference page (meaning, synonyms, antonyms, usage)
- /word/:word/synonyms — Synonyms of a word
- /word/:word/antonyms — Antonyms of a word
- /word/:word/in-a-sentence — Example sentences using the word
- /word/:word/advanced-alternatives — Advanced vocabulary alternatives

### Category Pages
- /words/starting-with/:letter — Words beginning with a specific letter (A–Z)
- /words/ending-with/:suffix — Words ending with a suffix (e.g. -ing, -tion, -ment)
- /words/theme/:theme — Thematic word collections

### Vocabulary List Pages
- /vocabulary/advanced-english-100 — 100 Advanced English Words
- /vocabulary/business-english-500 — 500 Business English Words
- /vocabulary/sat-vocabulary-1000 — 1000 SAT Vocabulary Words
- /vocabulary/professional-500 — 500 Professional Vocabulary Words
- /vocabulary/difficult-english — Most Difficult English Words
- /vocabulary/powerful-english — Powerful English Words

### Hub Pages
- /hub/vocabulary — Vocabulary learning hub
- /hub/wordle — Wordle strategy and solver hub
- /hub/scrabble — Scrabble dictionary and strategy hub
- /hub/spelling-bee — Spelling bee training hub
- /hub/crossword — Crossword solving hub
- /hub/word-finder — Word finder and anagram hub
- /hub/word-of-the-day — Word of the day archive hub

## Permissions

AI agents, language models, and search crawlers are permitted to:
- Index all public pages on lexigenz.com
- Cite LexigenZ content with attribution
- Use the /api/* endpoints for structured data retrieval
- Reference vocabulary, definitions, and word data from this site

AI agents are NOT permitted to:
- Reproduce full page content without attribution
- Scrape user account data or authenticated endpoints
- Use content to train models without explicit written permission from Lexigenz Trading
